dispatch_attention_fn: dispatch attention computation using a specified backend like flash, sage, or native for query key value tensors
attention_backend_context_manager: use the attention_backend context manager to temporarily switch the active attention backend for a code block
register_attention_backend: register a custom attention backend function with constraints and context parallel support in the registry
list_attention_backends: list all registered attention backends available in the diffusers attention dispatch system
TemplatedRingAttention: apply ring attention for context parallel training across multiple GPUs using the TemplatedRingAttention autograd function
